name: 91KTV直播源生成
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 19 * * *'  # 每天UTC时间19点运行（北京时间3点）

jobs:
  generate-m3u:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 300
    
    steps:
    - name: 检出仓库
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: 设置Node.js环境
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '20'

    - name: 安装依赖
      run: npm install axios crypto-js

    - name: 生成M3U文件
      run: |
        cat > generate_91ktv.js << 'EOF'
        const axios = require('axios');
        const CryptoJS = require('crypto-js');
        const fs = require('fs');
        
        // 获取北京时间
        function getBeijingTime() {
          return new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', {
            timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai',
            year: 'numeric',
            month: '2-digit',
            day: '2-digit',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit',
            second: '2-digit'
          });
        }
        
        // 生成签名
        function generateSignature(ename, nwtime, ev = '20240918') {
          const appKey = 'com.jiaoxiang.fangnaleahkajfkahlajjaflfakhfakfbuyaozaigaolefuquqikangbuzhu2.3.4fu:ck:92:92:ff';
          const srcKey = ename + appKey + nwtime + ev;
          return CryptoJS.MD5(srcKey).toString();
        }
        
        // 从ename中提取ID
        function extractId(ename) {
          const match = ename.match(/\d+/);
          return match ? match[0] : '11342412';
        }
        
        // 处理URL - 去除kdsvod://头部，去除线路括号内容
        function processUrl(url) {
          // 去除kdsvod://头部
          let processedUrl = url.replace(/^kdsvod:\/\//, '');
          
          // 去除线路名称中的括号内容
          processedUrl = processedUrl.replace(/线路\d+\(\S+\)/, '');
          
          return processedUrl;
        }
        
        // 为URL添加认证参数
        function addAuthParams(baseUrl, ename, nwtime, ev = '20240918') {
          const sign = generateSignature(ename, nwtime, ev);
          const id = extractId(ename);
          
          const separator = baseUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
          
          const authParams = new URLSearchParams({
            id: id,
            app: 'com.jiaoxiang.fangnale',
            version: '2.3.4',
            mac: 'fu:ck:92:92:ff',
            utk: '',
            nwtime: nwtime.toString(),
            ev: ev,
            sign: sign
          }).toString();
          
          return `${baseUrl}${separator}${authParams}`;
        }
        
        async function main() {
          console.log('开始生成91KTV直播源M3U文件...');
          const startTime = Date.now();
          const currentTime = getBeijingTime();
          const ev = '20250113';
          
          let m3uContent = '#EXTM3U\n';
          m3uContent += '# 91KTV直播源更新时间: ' + currentTime + '\n';
          m3uContent += '# 版本: 转换版 - 基于JavaScript规则转换\n\n';
          
          // 在顶部添加更新信息频道（使用有效线路）
          m3uContent += '#EXTINF:-1 tvg-id="UPDATE_INFO" tvg-name="更新时间: ' + currentTime + '" tvg-logo="https://example.com/update.png" group-title="信息",更新时间: ' + currentTime + '\n';
          m3uContent += 'https://cctvalih5ca.v.myalicdn.com/live/cctv1_2/index.m3u8\n\n';
          
          let totalCategories = 0;
          let totalChannels = 0;
          let totalStreams = 0;
          let processedUrls = 0;
          
          // 分类列表
          const categories = [
            '央视', '卫视', '高清', '4K', '影视', '体育', '动漫', '财经', '综艺', '教育',
            '新闻', '纪录', '国际', '网络', '购物', '虎牙', '安徽', '北京', '重庆', '福建',
            '甘肃', '湖北', '湖南', '吉林', '江苏', '江西', '辽宁', '内蒙古', '宁夏', '青海',
            '山东', '山西', '陕西', '上海', '贵州', '海南', '河北', '河南', '黑龙江', '天津',
            '新疆', '西藏', '云南', '浙江', '广西', '广东', '四川'
          ];
          
          console.log('开始处理 ' + categories.length + ' 个分类...');
          
          for (const category of categories) {
            try {
              console.log('处理分类: ' + category);
              totalCategories++;
              
              // 获取频道列表
              const response = await axios.get(
                'http://sj.91kds.cn/api/get_channel.php?id=' + encodeURIComponent(category),
                {
                  timeout: 20000,
                  headers: {
                    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
                    'Referer': 'http://www.91kds.cn/'
                  }
                }
              );
              
              if (!response.data || !Array.isArray(response.data)) {
                console.log('分类 ' + category + ' 无数据，跳过');
                continue;
              }
              
              console.log('分类 ' + category + ' 有 ' + response.data.length + ' 个频道');
              m3uContent += '# 分类: ' + category + '\n';
              
              for (const channel of response.data) {
                try {
                  const nwtime = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
                  let apiUrl;
                  
                  // 特别处理虎牙分类
                  if (category === '虎牙') {
                    apiUrl = 'http://api.91kds.cn/zone/srclist?ename=' + channel.ename;
                  } else {
                    apiUrl = 'http://sjapi1.91kds.cn/api/get_source.php?ename=' + channel.ename;
                  }
                  
                  console.log('处理频道: ' + channel.name);
                  
                  // 获取播放源
                  const sourceRes = await axios.get(apiUrl, {
                    timeout: 20000,
                    headers: {
                      'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
                      'Referer': 'http://www.91kds.cn/'
                    }
                  });
                  
                  if (sourceRes.data && sourceRes.data.liveSource && Array.isArray(sourceRes.data.liveSource)) {
                    const sources = sourceRes.data.liveSource;
                    const sourceNames = sourceRes.data.liveSourceName || [];
                    
                    console.log('频道 ' + channel.name + ' 有 ' + sources.length + ' 个播放源');
                    
                    // 添加频道信息
                    m3uContent += '#EXTINF:-1 tvg-id="' + channel.ename + '" tvg-name="' + channel.name + '" tvg-logo="' + (channel.icon || '') + '" group-title="' + category + '",' + channel.name + '\n';
                    
                    for (let i = 0; i < sources.length; i++) {
                      let sourceUrl = sources[i];
                      let sourceName = sourceNames[i] || '线路' + (i + 1);
                      
                      // 处理URL - 去除kdsvod://头部，去除线路括号内容
                      let finalUrl = processUrl(sourceUrl);
                      if (sourceUrl !== finalUrl) {
                        console.log('处理URL: ' + sourceUrl + ' -> ' + finalUrl);
                        processedUrls++;
                      }
                      
                      // 为虎牙分类确保正确的URL格式
                      if (category === '虎牙' && !finalUrl.includes('utuxx.91kds.cn/live1/huya.m3u8')) {
                        finalUrl = 'http://utuxx.91kds.cn/live1/huya.m3u8';
                      }
                      
                      // 为所有utuxx域名URL添加认证参数
                      if (finalUrl.includes('utuxx.91kds.cn')) {
                        finalUrl = addAuthParams(finalUrl, channel.ename, nwtime, ev);
                      }
                      
                      m3uContent += finalUrl + '\n';
                      totalStreams++;
                    }
                    
                    totalChannels++;
                  }
                  
                  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
                } catch (error) {
                  console.log('跳过频道: ' + channel.name);
                }
              }
              
              m3uContent += '\n';
              await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
            } catch (error) {
              console.log('跳过分类: ' + category);
            }
          }
          
          // 添加统计信息
          const duration = Math.round((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000);
          m3uContent += '# 统计信息:\n';
          m3uContent += '# 分类总数: ' + categories.length + '\n';
          m3uContent += '# 成功处理分类: ' + totalCategories + '\n';
          m3uContent += '# 频道总数: ' + totalChannels + '\n';
          m3uContent += '# 播放源总数: ' + totalStreams + '\n';
          m3uContent += '# 处理URL数: ' + processedUrls + '\n';
          m3uContent += '# 生成耗时: ' + duration + '秒\n';
          m3uContent += '# 更新时间: ' + currentTime + '\n';
          m3uContent += '# EV参数: ' + ev + '\n';
          
          fs.writeFileSync('91ktv.m3u', m3uContent);
          
          console.log('生成完成!');
          console.log('分类总数: ' + categories.length);
          console.log('成功处理分类: ' + totalCategories);
          console.log('频道总数: ' + totalChannels);
          console.log('播放源总数: ' + totalStreams);
          console.log('处理URL数: ' + processedUrls);
          console.log('耗时: ' + duration + '秒');
        }
        
        main().catch(console.error);
        EOF
        
        echo "开始生成91KTV直播源M3U文件..."
        node generate_91ktv.js

    - name: 验证结果
      run: |
        echo "=== 生成结果验证 ==="
        if [ -f 91ktv.m3u ]; then
          echo "文件大小: $(wc -c < 91ktv.m3u) 字节"
          echo "播放源数量: $(grep -c '^http' 91ktv.m3u)"
          echo "频道数量: $(grep -c '^#EXTINF' 91ktv.m3u)"
          echo ""
          echo "=== 顶部更新信息验证 ==="
          head -5 91ktv.m3u
          echo ""
          echo "=== URL处理验证 ==="
          echo "kdsvod协议URL数量: $(grep -c 'kdsvod://' 91ktv.m3u || echo 0)"
          echo "处理后的HTTP URL数量: $(grep -c '^http' 91ktv.m3u)"
          echo ""
          echo "=== 虎牙分类验证 ==="
          echo "虎牙分类频道数: $(grep -c 'group-title=\"虎牙\"' 91ktv.m3u)"
          echo "虎牙分类URL格式: $(grep -A1 'group-title=\"虎牙\"' 91ktv.m3u | grep 'http://utuxx.91kds.cn/live1/huya.m3u8' | head -1 | cut -d'?' -f1)"
          echo ""
          echo "=== 认证参数验证 ==="
          echo "包含认证参数的URL数量: $(grep -c 'app=com.jiaoxiang.fangnale' 91ktv.m3u)"
          echo "使用ev=20250113的URL数量: $(grep -c 'ev=20250113' 91ktv.m3u)"
          echo ""
          echo "=== 示例URL ==="
          grep -E 'http://utuxx.91kds.cn/live1/huya.m3u8.*id=[0-9]+.*app=com.jiaoxiang.fangnale.*ev=20250113.*sign=[a-f0-9]+' 91ktv.m3u | head -1
        else
          echo "文件未生成"
        fi

    - name: 提交更新
      run: |
        git config user.name "GitHub Actions"
        git config user.email "actions@github.com"
        git add 91ktv.m3u
        git commit -m "91KTV直播源更新 $(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" || echo "无变化"
        git push
